checks.text: The page displays the heading "Bucket List Tracker" and, with no entries, the text "No entries yet".

In the tab labelled "Entries", typing "Skydive" in the field labelled "Title", selecting "Adventure" in the select labelled "Category", and clicking the button "Add entry" creates a list item containing "Skydive" and "Adventure"; the text "No entries yet" is no longer visible.

Clicking the button "Add step" inside the "Skydive" item, typing "Book jump" in the field labelled "Step", and pressing Enter adds a checkable item "Book jump" to that entry's checklist; the progress indicator for "Skydive" shows "0/1".
Clicking the checkbox next to "Book jump" in the "Skydive" entry changes the progress indicator for "Skydive" to "1/1" and displays the text "Complete" next to the entry title.
Typing "Sky" in the input labelled "Search" filters the list to show only the item "Skydive"; typing "Ocean" in the same input shows the text "No entries yet".
Clicking the button "Export CSV" displays a toast with the text "Exported 1 entry" and triggers a download of a file containing the line "Skydive,Adventure,1/1".
Clicking the button "Edit" on the "Skydive" item opens a form; changing the field labelled "Title" to "Bungee" and clicking "Save" updates the list item to show "Bungee" instead of "Skydive".
Clicking the button "Delete" on the "Bungee" item removes it from the list; the list then shows the text "No entries yet".
Reload keeps the entry "Skydive" with category "Adventure" and the checked step "Book jump" visible in the list.
